text.hero-intro: sent to your inbox every month. Free to read, self-published with love.
text.signup-text: Leave your email and every new issue is sent to you. It costs nothing.
text.signup-consent: I agree that Backpocket may use my email address to send me the zine.
text.artists-title: Want to be in the zine?
text.artists-text: We publish work by independent artists. Tell us who you are and send a link to your work.
text.artists-link-label: Link to your work (website or Instagram)
text.artists-consent: I agree that Backpocket may contact me about my submission.
text.artists-success: Thank you! We got your submission and will be in touch.
text.thanks-text: The zine will be sent to your inbox.
text.thanks-ask: Backpocket is free and always will be. If you’d like to help cover the cost of making it, you can chip in.
text.thanks-no: No thanks, back to the site
text.what-text: Backpocket is an independent, monthly pocket-gallery zine made by multiple artists for your enjoyment. Each issue brings together small collages, drawings and words from different artists, sent straight to your inbox.

meta.title: Backpocket_Zine a portable gallery
